paragraphs.source_en: After Odai married into the family, Aku moved to the other side of the servants’ quarters. As if under a spell, Hirotada walked into her room. It was not Aku he longed for. Even as he stood before Aku, it was Odai’s image that appeared in his mind.

units.source_en: After Odai married into the family, Aku moved to the other side of the servants’ quarters.
units.source_zh: 自从於大嫁过来，阿久便搬到了长屋对面。

units.source_en: As if under a spell, Hirotada walked into her room.
units.source_zh: 广忠像着了魔似的走进那里。

units.source_en: It was not Aku he longed for.

ja.t: しかったわけではない。

units.source_zh: 他并非想念阿久。

units.source_en: Even as he stood before Aku, it was Odai’s image that appeared in his mind.
units.source_zh: 站在阿久面前，他眼前浮现的还是於大的影子。

paragraphs.source_zh: 自从於大嫁过来，阿久便搬到了长屋对面。广忠像着了魔似的走进那里。他并非想念阿久。站在阿久面前，他眼前浮现的还是於大的影子。

paragraphs.source_en: Only then did he see Lady Aku clearly, her figure merging with Odai’s image. He had once reproached Aku for showing no jealousy; now he saw that behind her jealousy, forbearance, and allure lay an unshakable confidence. Hirotada knew what his late-night visit meant to this woman, several years his senior. He had seen through her heart, and found himself comparing Aku with Odai.

units.source_en: Only then did he see Lady Aku clearly, her figure merging with Odai’s image.
units.source_zh: 此时，他才清楚地看到了阿久夫人，她和於大的影子重合在一起。

units.source_en: He had once reproached Aku for showing no jealousy; now he saw that behind her jealousy, forbearance, and allure lay an unshakable confidence.

ja.t: めたことがあった。だが

units.source_zh: 当初他曾经责备阿久为何没有嫉妒之心，现在他看到，在阿久的嫉妒、宽容以及妩媚的背后，隐藏着自信。

units.source_en: Hirotada knew what his late-night visit meant to this woman, several years his senior. He had seen through her heart, and found himself comparing Aku with Odai.
units.source_zh: 广忠知道自己的深夜来访对这个年长他几岁的女人意味着什么，他已经看透了这个女人的心，不由比较起阿久和於大来。

paragraphs.source_zh: 此时，他才清楚地看到了阿久夫人，她和於大的影子重合在一起。当初他曾经责备阿久为何没有嫉妒之心，现在他看到，在阿久的嫉妒、宽容以及妩媚的背后，隐藏着自信。广忠知道自己的深夜来访对这个年长他几岁的女人意味着什么，他已经看透了这个女人的心，不由比较起阿久和於大来。

paragraphs.source_en: “Will you not retire yet, my lord?”

units.source_en: “Will you not retire yet, my lord?”

ja.t: みにならないのですか」

units.source_zh: “您还不歇息吗？”

units.source_en: “Mm.”

paragraphs.source_en: “The night wind is cold,” Aku said.

units.source_en: “The night wind is cold,”
units.source_zh: “夜风很冷。”

units.source_en: Aku said.
units.source_zh: 阿久道。

paragraphs.source_en: Hirotada looked at Aku once more. Again her figure merged with Odai’s, leaving him at a loss. Aku made another’s misfortune her own delight, while Odai bore no resentment at all. Innocent and wise, she merely waited in silence, enduring the pain of being neglected. The thought made Hirotada turn sharply around, ready to leave.

units.source_en: Hirotada looked at Aku once more. Again her figure merged with Odai’s, leaving him at a loss.
units.source_zh: 广忠又看了一眼阿久，她的影子再次和於大重合在一起，他不知所措。

units.source_en: Aku made another’s misfortune her own delight, while Odai bore no resentment at all. Innocent and wise, she merely waited in silence, enduring the pain of being neglected.
units.source_zh: 阿久把别人的不幸当成自己的快乐，於大却毫不计较，天真聪慧的她只是静静地等待，忍受着被冷落的痛苦。

units.source_en: The thought made Hirotada turn sharply around, ready to leave.
units.source_zh: 一思及此，广忠猛地转过身，便欲离去。

paragraphs.source_zh: 广忠又看了一眼阿久，她的影子再次和於大重合在一起，他不知所措。阿久把别人的不幸当成自己的快乐，於大却毫不计较，天真聪慧的她只是静静地等待，忍受着被冷落的痛苦。一思及此，广忠猛地转过身，便欲离去。

paragraphs.source_en: “Oh?” Aku uttered the sound with equal disappointment.

units.source_en: “Oh?”
Aku uttered the sound with equal disappointment.
units.source_zh: 同样失望的声音从阿久口中发出。

paragraphs.source_zh: “啊？”同样失望的声音从阿久口中发出。

paragraphs.source_en: Holding his head high, Hirotada walked back along the corridor. It was bitterly cold outside. A wind seemed to have risen, and the pines in the courtyard rustled.

units.source_en: Holding his head high, Hirotada walked back along the corridor.
units.source_zh: 广忠昂着头，走回廊里。

units.source_en: It was bitterly cold outside. A wind seemed to have risen, and the pines in the courtyard rustled.
units.source_zh: 外面很冷，似乎起风了，院子里的松树沙沙作响。

paragraphs.source_zh: 广忠昂着头，走回廊里。外面很冷，似乎起风了，院子里的松树沙沙作响。

paragraphs.source_en: Yuri and Suga were astonished to see Hirotada return. Without looking at them, Hirotada strode solemnly into the inner chamber.

units.source_en: Yuri and Suga were astonished to see Hirotada return.
units.source_zh: 百合和须贺看见广忠回来，很是惊讶。

units.source_en: Without looking at them, Hirotada strode solemnly into the inner chamber.
units.source_zh: 广忠并不看她们，一脸严肃地径自走进内室。

paragraphs.source_zh: 百合和须贺看见广忠回来，很是惊讶。广忠并不看她们，一脸严肃地径自走进内室。

paragraphs.source_en: The quilt trembled more violently, and Hirotada could dimly make out Odai’s face. Her eyes were already moist, but she was still struggling to master her feelings.

units.source_en: The quilt trembled more violently, and Hirotada could dimly make out Odai’s face.
units.source_zh: 被子越发颤抖得厉害，广忠隐隐约约看到了於大的面庞。

units.source_en: Her eyes were already moist, but she was still struggling to master her feelings.
units.source_zh: 她的眼已经湿润了，但还在努力控制自己的感情。

paragraphs.source_zh: 被子越发颤抖得厉害，广忠隐隐约约看到了於大的面庞。她的眼已经湿润了，但还在努力控制自己的感情。

units.source_en: “Please, do not cry any more.”
units.source_zh: “莫再哭了，好吗？”

units.source_en: “Yes.”

paragraphs.source_en: “It is all my fault. Do not cry any more.”

units.source_en: “It is all my fault.
units.source_zh: “都是我不好。

units.source_en: Do not cry any more.”
units.source_zh: 莫再哭了。”

paragraphs.source_en: In the adjoining room, Yuri and Suga heard every word of their conversation. A blush rose to both their faces at once, and they smiled and nodded to each other.

units.source_en: In the adjoining room, Yuri and Suga heard every word of their conversation.
units.source_zh: 隔壁的百合和须贺真真切切地听到了他们的谈话。

units.source_en: A blush rose to both their faces at once, and they smiled and nodded to each other.
units.source_zh: 两人脸上不约而同泛起红晕，微笑着点了点头。

paragraphs.source_zh: 隔壁的百合和须贺真真切切地听到了他们的谈话。两人脸上不约而同泛起红晕，微笑着点了点头。
